name: Sexual Health
shortDescription: RoMIUS Urology provides advanced, compassionate care for men experiencing sexual health concerns. Our specialists offer state-of-the-art diagnostics, medical therapies, and minimally invasive treatments—tailored to restore confidence, improve function, and enhance overall quality of life. We treat the full spectrum of male sexual health conditions with expertise, discretion, and a patient-centered approach for men throughout Northwest and West Central Ohio.
body:
Erectile Dysfunction (ED)

Erectile dysfunction is one of the most common men’s health concerns, and RoMIUS Urology provides the full range of modern, evidence-based treatments. Our evaluation identifies root causes such as vascular disease, hormonal imbalance, nerve injury, or medication effects so patients receive truly personalized care.

A key part of our philosophy is guiding patients toward the most cost-effective treatment options, especially since many ED therapies are elective and not always covered by insurance. We help patients navigate affordable medication pathways, generics, compounding options, and cost-efficient device therapies to ensure they receive high-value care without unnecessary expense.

RoMIUS Urology is also recognized as a center of excellence for penile implantation, having performed the highest volume of penile implants in the region with exceptional outcomes and patient satisfaction. For patients who require long-term correction, our expertise in prosthetic urology offers safe, effective, and durable solutions.

Peyronie’s Disease

Peyronie’s disease may cause penile curvature, pain, or difficulty with sexual function. RoMIUS Urology offers the latest diagnostic tools and a complete spectrum of treatments—from medical management and collagenase (Xiaflex®) injections to minimally invasive or surgical straightening procedures when necessary. Our goal is to restore both form and function, helping patients regain confidence with individualized, outcome-driven care.

Testosterone Therapy

Low testosterone (hypogonadism) can affect energy, libido, mood, muscle mass, and overall well-being. We provide a thorough, evidence-based evaluation to distinguish true hormone deficiency from other causes of symptoms. Treatment options include topical gels, short- and long-acting injections, and long-duration pellet implants. Each patient receives a customized monitoring plan to ensure safe, effective, and optimized hormone therapy. We also account for fertility preservation, metabolic health, and long-term hormonal balance.

Premature Ejaculation (PE)

Premature ejaculation is one of the most common and under-treated men’s sexual health concerns. RoMIUS Urology offers evidence-based treatments including topical anesthetics, oral medications, pelvic floor therapies, and behavioral strategies. We focus on improving control, reducing anxiety, and restoring confidence for both patients and couples through personalized, effective management.

Low Libido / Sexual Desire Concerns

Decreased sexual desire can stem from hormonal imbalance, stress, chronic illness, fatigue, medication effects, or relationship factors. Our team performs a comprehensive evaluation—including hormone testing, metabolic screening, and psychological contributors—to identify the true cause. Treatments are tailored to restore healthy sexual desire, improve overall well-being, and support long-term sexual health.
